m: a-yukta mfn. (√ yuj), not yoked, RV. x, 27, 9; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
not applied or made use of (see -cāra below)
not attentive, not devout, RV. v, 33, 3; ŚBr. &c.
a: ayukta a. 1 Not yoked or harnessed. 2 Not joined, united or connected. 3 Not devout or pious, inattentive, negligent. 4 Unpractised, unused, unemployed; ˚buddhi, ˚cāra. 5 Unfit, improper, unsuitable; ayuktoyaṃ nirdeśaḥ P. IV. 2. 64, Mbh. 6 Untrue, wrong. 7 Unmarried. 8 Opening externally. 9 Reduced to straits, miserable. Comp. — karman n. an official (perhaps for āyukta˚). — kṛt a. doing improper or wrong acts. — padārthaḥ the sense of a word to be supplied, as the sense of api q. v. — rūpa a. incongruous, unsuitable; ˚paṃ kimataḥparaṃ vada Ku. 5. 69.
